summary: Traced CI from the default-branch workflow through trusted PR metadata, fetched Git objects, the base evidence schema and isolated optional App publication. Candidate files and workflow artifacts are never executed by the independent gate. The version-only classifier falls back to ordinary evidence for unrecognized files, source changes and mode changes.

tests.evidence: Real disposable Git repositories: tampered candidate with stale evidence fails, current evidence passes, moved head fails; no candidate code executed.
26 tests passed, including broader bot updates with full evidence and supply-chain negative cases.
No findings after manual added-line review.

limitations: Hosted independent gate starts after merge. Private App credential, protected environment and branch rule must be configured by the maintainer. Expected source enforcement and live merge denial require administrator verification.
Local integration used synthetic GitHub metadata. Runtime router/agent code was unchanged.
